messages:
ara: Heads-up — customer acme-inc reports multiple console preview panels failing to load. Getting 500s/timeouts from analytics-api when the dashboard calls the /query endpoint since ~11:20 PDT. Repro steps below. Anyone available to triage?

ara: Repro (curl):
```
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.cloud/analytics/query' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"panel_id":"pv-12","range":"24h","granularity":"1m"}'
```

ara: Response: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"error":"timeout","details":"query execution exceeded 30000ms","trace_id":"t-abc123"}

miles: I'm on it. Saw a latency spike from analytics-aggregator around 11:18–11:25. p95 jumped to ~7.2s, p99 ~18s. Replica 2 is showing high CPU and stuck queries.

ops-bot: deploy: analytics-aggregator v1.4.2 -> v1.4.3 started by @jordan at 11:34 PDT :rocket:

kat: Can we check the ingest backlog and ClickHouse query times? If the materialized views are behind, queries can blow past the 30s timeout. Also confirm etl-worker lag.

jordan: quick dump of aggregator logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-17T18:20:45Z] ERROR query-runner - Query execution timeout after 30000ms, query_id=q-9f7e
[2026-03-17T18:21:02Z] WARN  kv-cache - cache miss for prefix pv-12
[2026-03-17T18:21:45Z] ERROR clickhouse-client - timeout while reading from socket
```

jordan: Pushing an emergency patch: bump analytics-proxy timeout to 60s and enable sampling fallback for heavy panels. Deploy in 2m. If that reduces 500s we can follow with scaling.

ash: Heads-up: PR #842 adds:
```
analytics-proxy.conf:
  max_query_time_ms: 60000
  enable_sampling_fallback: true
  max_retries: 2
```
Rolling this to staging now.

sam: Noted earlier this morning we had a few 402s from billing for acme-inc (billing token expired) which caused some API errors for their ingestion pipeline — unclear if related to query engine load but calling it out.

miles: Correlation: two tenants had billing token failures ~30m before; that caused a retry surge to ingestion which temporarily increased load. After scaling aggregator replicas 3->5 and landing PR #842, p95 dropped to ~1.1s and 500s fell off.

support-bot: ticket created: #INC-78934 for acme-inc (linked to support thread).

ara: Nice. TL;DR of actions: 1) increased aggregator replicas (3->5), 2) patched analytics-proxy (timeout 30s->60s + sampling fallback), 3) confirmed billing token expired for tenant (billing alerted customer).

kat: Follow-ups: add a dashboard alert for ingestion-backlog > 5m, add runbook step to check tenant billing state before triage, and consider a temporary client-side graceful degradation for preview panels.

ara: I'll update the customer with the mitigation and ETA for permanent fix. Will move to incident channel if we see recurrence. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

miles: marking as resolved for now, will keep monitoring for 2 hours. :eyes:
